items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-09
items.q: The name 'Mr. Clinton' is only mentioned by the interviewer as the author of a letter ('His answer to Mr. Clinton'). The interviewee does not mention Mr. Clinton, nor does he describe any personal or professional relationship with him.

ctx.x: This is a letter headed. New Orleans Jazz Club, 2417 Octavia Street, New Orleans 15, Louisiana. October 18, 1957. Mr. David L. Herman, 107 Camp Street, New Orleans 12, Louisiana. Dear Dave Cullen, I read with interest your letter of October 14th relative to your client, Mr. Nicola Riker, and the possibility of an appearance by him and by Mr. Tom P. Brown to present proof and facts supporting their respective claims. Period. New paragraph. Before any plans could be made for such an occasion, comma, it is necessary…
Yeah, I'll read Brown's letter now. His answer to Mr. Clinton.

Tom, this is letter headed. Tom Brown's Music Shop, Musical Instruments and Supplies. It was at 3027 Magazine Street. He has that marked out. His new address is 1228th Street, New Orleans, Louisiana. October 21st, 1957. Herman and Herman, 107 Cam Street, New Orleans, Louisiana. Dear Sir, semicolon dash. I received a letter dated October 14th, address, comma, address to me, comma, and the enclosure written to Harry Sushant of the New Orleans Jazz Club. I opened the letter because my name was on the envelope,…
